description: The observation loop found a verified artifact (memoryNote cycle-demo-3) that is no longer valid: it was previously verified to byte-equal 9, but now incorrectly states that 'The word resilient has 10 letters'. This disagreement indicates a violation in the artifact's integrity that requires investigation to determine the mechanism that caused the degradation.
